title: 三峡再砸772亿:深度揭秘大坝的安全真相与电力家族的资本帝国  20260619【新闻大写】
executive_summary: The video discusses the Three Gorges Dam in China, focusing on its safety, financial aspects, and the capital empire surrounding it. The dam, a massive engineering project, has been in operation for 30 years and is undergoing further investment of 77.2 billion yuan for a new channel. The video aims to uncover the history, controversies, and financial machinations behind the dam and the company responsible, China Yangtze Power.
